Environment.description_en: The environment definition. An environment can be associated with a specific branch for development iterations or with an infrastructure stack to deploy services to a specified environment
Environment.description_zh: 环境可以与用于开发迭代的特定分支相关联，也可以与基础结构堆栈相关联，以便将服务部署到指定的环境

createdTime.description_en: The server time when this object was created. This field is read-only
createdTime.description_zh: 创建此对象时服务器的时间，只读
createdTime.title: 创建此对象时服务器的时间，只读

generation.description_en: The auto-incremented sequence number of the current configuration. This field is populated by the system and is read-only. It increments when the spec is updated
generation.description_zh: 当前配置的自增的序列号，由系统填充，只读。当spec更新时递增
generation.title: 当前资源的自增的序列号，由系统填充，只读，当spec、labels、description更新时递增。如果指定，系统会加入并发写校验，generation必须和系统中的状态值一致

kind.description_en: The type of the current resource. This field is read-only
kind.title: 当前资源的类型，只读

additionalProperties.description_en: The value of the resource label

name.description_en: The environment name. It is unique within the project and cannot be modified
name.description_zh: 环境名称，项目下唯一，不可修改
name.title: 环境名称，项目下唯一，不可修改

projectName.description_en: The name of the project to which the environment belongs. This field is read-only
projectName.description_zh: 环境所属的项目名称，只读
projectName.title: 环境所属的项目名称，只读

status.description_en: The status of the current environment
status.title: 当前环境的状态

uid.description_en: The ID of the current Alibaba Cloud account. This field is read-only
uid.description_zh: 当前阿里云主账号的ID，只读
uid.title: 当前阿里云主账号的ID，只读

Environment.title: 环境定义

roleArn.description_en: The role ARN of the environment
roleArn.title: 环境角色

stagedConfigs.description_en: The configurations saved in the environment. You can reach the desired configuration state through deployment
stagedConfigs.description_zh: 环境下保存的配置，可以通过部署达到该配置状态
stagedConfigs.title: 环境下保存的配置，可以通过部署达到该配置状态

type.description_en: The environment type. Valid values: testing, staging, and production
type.description_zh: 环境类型，只能在testing、staging、production中选择
type.title: 环境类型，只能在testing、staging、production中选择

latestEnvironmentDeploymentName.description_en: The name of the latest deployment plan. Each environment deployment generates a deployment plan that involves the deployment of multiple services
latestEnvironmentDeploymentName.description_zh: 最近一次部署计划的名称。每次环境部署都会产生一个部署计划，涉及若干个服务的部署
latestEnvironmentDeploymentName.title: 最近一次部署计划的名称。每次环境部署都会产生一个部署计划，涉及若干个服务的部署

observedGeneration.description_en: The latest resource generation observed by the system
observedGeneration.description_zh: 系统最新观测到的资源generation
observedGeneration.title: 资源最近的一次状态更新时的资源generation

observedTime.description_en: The time of the last status update for the resource
observedTime.description_zh: 资源最近的一次状态更新时间
observedTime.title: 资源最近的一次状态更新时间

servicesInstances.description_en: The service instances generated after services in the project are deployed by using the configurations in the current environment
servicesInstances.description_zh: 项目下的服务使用当前环境中的配置进行部署后产生的服务实例
servicesInstances.title: 项目下的服务使用当前环境中的配置进行部署后产生的服务实例

items.description_zh: 存在未部署变更的服务名称

description_zh: 批量查询满足条件的环境

parameters.help_zh: 利用实体的labels字段进行筛选。精确匹配labelSelector数组中的所有条件，不同条件之间是“且”的关系
parameters.name: label_selector

parameters.help_en: The current page number. Default value: 1. Pages start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页码，默认为1。页码从1开始

parameters.help_zh: 每页大小，默认为100。取值范围1~100

parameters.help_zh: 模糊搜索关键词。仅支持实体的name字段，且大小写不敏感
parameters.name: keyword
